title: Degree-zero descent for a fixed pullback sheaf
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ an inverse system of quasi-compact quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition maps, with limit cone $(X,(p_i))$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. Fix $i\in I$ and an abelian sheaf $F$ on $(D_i)_{\acute{e}t}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For every $y\in H^0(X,p_i^{-1}F)$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image, def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], there exist $j\in I$, $f:i\to j$, and $x\in H^0(D_j,D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F)$ such that $p_j^*(x)=H^0(\alpha_f)(y)$ [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], where $\alpha_f:p_i^{-1}F\cong p_j^{-1}D(f^{\mathrm{op}})^{-1}F$ is the canonical inverse-image composition isomorphism from $D(f^{\mathrm{op}})\circ p_j=p_i$.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Tag 09YQ (label theorem-colimit), degree zero for a fixed inverse-image sheaf, via 0EYL, 04HR, 09YN and 03S2.

proof.text: Restrict to the nonempty cofinal upper tail of i. Identify degree-zero cohomology with global sections by H.equiv₀ and the degree-zero pullback/unit formula.

For affine etale objects, the affine etale-site colimit and affine-topos equivalence identify inverse images compatibly with units. Apply the colimit-site section comparison. For the identity etale object of a qcqs stage choose a finite affine cover and finite affine refinements of overlaps. Descend local sections and the finitely many equality equations to one common stage, then glue by the sheaf equalizer. Filtered colimits commute with these finite equalizers.

Translate the descended section back to H^0. The unit compatibility of the composition comparison gives precisely the displayed equation. Empty schemes and zero sheaves have the zero class represented as zero; nonempty indexing supplies a stage.

proof_origin.place: Degree-zero fixed-coefficient section descent with finite affine-cover gluing.

theorem fixed_pullback_degree_zero_descent
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ (i j : Iᵒᵖ) (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)]
    (i : I) (F : Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (y : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op i))).obj F) 0) :
    ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j)
      (x : Sheaf.H ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (D.map f.op)).obj F) 0),
      cohomologyMap (c.π.app (op j)) _ 0 x =
        Sheaf.H.map
          ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} (c.π.app (op j)) (D.map f.op)
            (c.π.app (op i)) (c.w f.op).symm).hom.app F) 0 y
